name: Shared Shell Foundation
summary: Base shared viewmodel infrastructure and the shared MainWindow shell used to support the top-right user menu, title-bar page search with direct navigation and settings deep-links, a persistent pane-footer label-launch cluster above the built-in Settings item, the embedded settings-mode NavigationView swap, and reusable icon selection UI.

validationHints: Confirm the top-right shell user menu opens and triggers logout correctly
Confirm the main shell resets back to Receiving after a successful switch-user login
Confirm title-bar search suggestions open the expected page or settings destination without leaving the shell in a mismatched navigation state
Confirm the shared label-launch footer remains in the same pane position above Settings when the shell switches between app mode and settings mode
Confirm the shared shell swaps its NavigationView items in and out of settings mode without leaving the selection or header out of sync
Confirm shared shell viewmodels and reusable icon selection behavior remain aligned
